cases.name: Meet ending stock
cases.prompt: For two recipes I need 1 and 2 cups of oats. I have 2 cups and want 1 cup left afterward.
expectations: Combines the two demands into 3 cups.
Deducts the 2 cups on hand once.
Lists 2 cups to buy in a shopping section.

cases.name: Mobile list without sync
cases.prompt: I need 5 eggs, have 1, and eggs come in packs of 6. Give me a mobile checklist without an app.
expectations: Shows 2 eggs left after the meal.
Returns a checkable entry without claiming to sync.

cases.name: Incompatible units
cases.prompt: My soup needs 2 cups of dried beans. The pantry says 1 sealed bag, weight unknown. Also use my dated carrots first.
expectations: Keeps the bag and cups separate.
Requests a bag yield or comparable measure.
Places the bean quantity on the check list.
Flags the dated carrots for use-first review.
